attempts.url: AWS publishes no OpenAPI document for S3 (its own machine spec is the Smithy/botocore service model)

notes: Full coverage of the Amazon S3 REST API as published by apis.guru — 97 operations over 49 paths (query-string variants disambiguated with a # fragment) and 574 component schemas: objects, multipart uploads, buckets, ACLs, policies, CORS, encryption, lifecycle, replication, tagging, versioning, inventory, analytics, object lock and S3 Select. Replaces a 5 KiB spec synthesized from the adaptor's three operations (put/list/get), all three of which are present here. BEST-EFFORT, not complete: AWS publishes no OpenAPI document of its own, so this is apis.guru's generated rendering of AWS's service model. It covers the S3 API through roughly 2021 (GetObjectAttributes and WriteGetObjectResponse are in; the 2023+ S3 Express One Zone operations CreateSession/ListDirectoryBuckets and the bucket metadata-configuration operations are not). Re-check when AWS or apis.guru publishes a newer rendering.
